message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The scenario: High (高某) used a brick to hit Wang (王某某) causing light injury (轻伤). This is an assault causing bodily injury. In Chinese criminal law, causing light injury by assault is "故意伤害罪" (intentional injury). The fact that he used a brick, causing head injury, qualifies as intentional injury. Also there is prior criminal record but not relevant. So the charge: "故意伤害罪". Possibly also "聚众斗殴"? But only one victim. The act is assault with a weapon (brick). The crime is intentional injury. So answer: [罪名]故意伤害<eoa>.
